README.md: State the educational objective, scope, phase, project ID, current stage and exact next action. No implementation exists at scaffold time.
ORIGIN_AND_ATTRIBUTION.md: Record original work, original authors, organization, original source/repository, license, intended reproduction, independently implemented elements, modifications and educational purpose. Unknown fields remain UNVERIFIED — source required. Preserve upstream LICENSE/NOTICE. No implementation or modification exists yet.
DESIGN.md: Define the problem, intended behavior, inputs, outputs, invariants, assumptions, exclusions and unresolved design decisions before coding.
ARCHITECTURE.md: Describe proposed components, interfaces, control/data flow, state ownership, storage and trust boundaries. Separate proposal from inspected implementation.
PREREQUISITES.md: Link required unit gates and actual learner evidence. No prerequisite is satisfied merely because its document exists.
BUILD_LOG.md: Append dated actual actions, commands, environment and outputs. At scaffold time no build or execution has occurred.
EXPERIMENTS.md: Register planned experiments, hypotheses and failure tests; preserve actual raw evidence after execution. No observations exist yet.
TESTS.md: Specify normal, edge, negative and failure cases, expected behavior, invariants and test commands once implemented. Current execution status: NOT RUN.
RESULTS.md: NOT YET OBSERVED. Later link actual outputs and analysis, scope, uncertainty, failures and alternative explanations. No performance or correctness claim is established.
REFERENCES.md: List candidate resource IDs now. Before reproduction add inspected original locations, pinned revisions and license evidence; before behavior claims inspect relevant implementation.
